hardening.minimized_reason: No feature-minimization claim has been established for this package.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Paperless-ngx for werewolf's paperless form, as Wolfi would package it. The release tarball carries the built web interface. uv installs what uv.lock pins, into a virtual environment on Wolfi's Python 3.13 at /usr/lib/paperless. The assistant's packages (torch, llama-index, sentence-transformers) are left out: nothing imports them until a chat runs, and this form does not run one. OCR programs are not in this package. The form installs Wolfi's tesseract, ghostscript, ImageMagick, poppler and qpdf, which the updater can replace. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships Paperless, the form names the package and this file goes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
